target_surface: Authenticated Ampere warehouse scanner daily reconciliation dialog and same-origin server API
request_summary: Replace the operator's changing Excel label-count comparison with an automatic daily package reconciliation ledger and export.
included_pages: Existing StockItUp process-automation audit conclusions about label, handoff, and source ownership
excluded_pages: Creating a StockItUp API key or mutating StockItUp settings
Bol shipment, order, label, or account writes
Carrier acceptance, in-transit, delivery, returns, inventory, or finance automation
Claims that bol shipment observation proves the exact label-print timestamp
active_rules: Bol remains authoritative for shipment identity, tracking, order-item cancellation, and source timestamps.
The scanner remains authoritative for physical handoff scans.
Turso stores only additive ampere_* reconciliation state and audit history.
Browser code calls same-origin APIs and never submits operational source facts for persistence.
A source refresh commits reconciliation facts only after every configured account and stable page enumeration validates.
Account incarnation follows the credential fingerprint so credential replacement cannot merge seller histories.
A physical package is deduplicated by account incarnation and tracking identity while retaining all shipment and order-item membership.
Amsterdam workdays use half-open 16:00 boundaries; late observations are explicit adjustments.
Existing FIFO, Enter-only scan, automatic refocus, auth, and fail-closed behavior remain unchanged.
tool_surfaces: approved GitHub repository and ZanderBMC release identity
external_account_policy: No new external account access in this branch build; StockItUp ingestion remains an unconnected server-side source boundary.
content_truth_policy: Use bol shipment observed language until an authoritative StockItUp label-created event is connected; never present inferred timestamps as exact label-print events.

verified: The existing scanner currently computes package totals from a moving browser shipment snapshot.
Bol shipmentDateTime and shipment/item detail are available through the current read-only server adapter.
Accepted and cancelled scanner decisions are persisted in ampere_* state and audit tables.
StockItUp currently owns label generation but has no configured API key in the audited tenant.
Bol permits multiple shipment records to share one physical tracking identity.
inferred: A bol-observed reconciliation ledger removes the changing-snapshot problem immediately while exact label-created parity waits for the StockItUp source event.
unknown: The exact StockItUp label event and permission scope available to a future least-privilege API key.
The amount of historical label detail StockItUp can backfill.
